remediationContract.neededExplicitLearnerFlow: Where current stage/subject selection excludes the Mathematics target route, independently verify the permitted first-party Cockpit action that selects appropriate Mathematics preparation under the same jurisdiction. The coach may not silently mutateLevel2, broadenfocus, changejurisdiction, or manufactureMastery.
remediationContract.bwSpecificGap: The v3 candidate does not require fullREP and does not promoteREP to target. Intrinsic place-value teaching needs actual independent performance/content review.
remediationContract.otherMissingRoutes: Any state/view with no inherited candidate target needs independently accepted explicit goalEntry placement in its source-supported lower-secondary year/band; do not blanket-insert by phase or by matching a convenient sibling.
